profile_text.body:
The National Student Clearinghouse is a nonprofit that describes itself as the source for trusted, authenticated, and secure education data insights. It says its verification, data exchange, and compliance services help institutions maximize time, resources, and knowledge, and that it provides educators, learners, businesses, and policymakers with the right data for the right use at the right time. Its site also notes that spoofing in higher education has become more sophisticated in the age of artificial intelligence and describes understanding its forms and signs as one way to help combat it.

The organization is tracked as an education and research product with no AI features recorded. Its use is college enrollment and completion tracking, aimed at district and counseling staff as a staff tool. A signed StudentTracker agreement is required, and StudentTracker for High Schools is priced at $595 per high school per year for unlimited use.
